conflictRegister.detail: R-21 and R-22 bind the R-18 hub pose to PI-30-006-FL; R-23 leaves it unbound with UNBOUND_NO_HUB_BODY. R-27 keeps a candidate role marker, not a rigid part pose.
R-23 run inputRevision=3, snapshot revision=1. Strict poseRun is STALE with no current frames; only a DEMO view with a stale badge is exposed.
R-21 maps 13 of 278 R-16 instances. The other 265 remain canonical R-16 nodes with no R-17 projection; they are not deleted or invented.
R-26 status is approved; no output artifacts found. R-27 preserves all R-21/R-22 conflicts and does not auto-resolve them.

R-21 maps 27 R-17 frames across both R-17 fixtures; this snapshot includes 21 FL wheel-end fixture frames. The remaining frames stay outside the FL motion slice; nonzero-origin counts differ accordingly.

decisions.decision: Snapshot variant is R-16 VAR-R16-BOF-ICE; R-17 VV-A-SWB-STD is a projection-only fixture variant. Alignment is BLOCKED, not assumed.
decisions.ask: GPT-6/RP-07 to declare the variant alignment relationship or keep them separate.

decisions.decision: Strict poseRun is STALE because R-23 revision 3 differs from snapshot revision 1. Only a DEMO motion view with a stale badge is exposed; hub is a candidate role marker, tie rod is required but deferred.
decisions.ask: R-28 to publish a run bound to the snapshot revision; GPT-6 to confirm the hub role-pose policy.

decisions.decision: All 278 engineering instances remain NO_GEOMETRY; all 37 canonical frames remain UNANCHORED_UNKNOWN. Only projection frames carry DEMO numeric origins.
decisions.ask: RP-07 to supply sourced frame anchors and geometry before production rendering.

decisions.decision: PI-* is the only canonical selection key. INST-*/ASM-* are projection aliases and never selection keys. R-21 maps 13/278; the other 265 remain canonical-only.
decisions.ask: R-17 contract and workbench consumers to accept the PI-* primary key.

decisions.decision: Quantity is derived by counting physical PI instances; qtyPerCorner is not multiplied. All 12 declared qty conflicts remain OPEN.
decisions.ask: GPT-6 to adopt this quantity policy in D-04.

decisions.decision: R-21 placeholder flags, name drift, parent drift and frame granularity differences are preserved; no RP-01 name or parent is rewritten.
decisions.ask: GPT-6 to adjudicate placeholders and parent-level rules.

decisions.decision: No source-grade promotion. R-16 external refs stay UNVERIFIED_REFERENCE; DEMO assets stay DEMO_SUBSTITUTE; forged sources fail closed.
decisions.ask: GPT-6 to establish the evidence registry and OEM verification workflow.

decisions.decision: R-26 output is missing; R-27 preserves all R-21/R-22 conflicts instead of auto-resolving them.
decisions.ask: Qwen4 R-26 to publish the conflict decision matrix; then R-27 can incorporate it.

decisions.decision: This snapshot is read-only for Composer R-29; no production workbench file is modified by R-27.
decisions.ask: Composer R-29 to consume the snapshot behind a feature flag and report unsupported fields.

r16ExternalRefs.note: R-16 external source IDs were not re-opened in R-27. No string is promoted to SOURCED or OEM.
